info.title: YalaInsight API
info.description: Solar plant intelligence, financial loss analytics and asset lifecycle platform. All endpoints are versioned under /api/v1. Authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer <token>` (from /api/v1/auth/login) or `X-API-Key` for machine clients.
